# hallpass_server (Data Source)

Looks up a server or git remote by alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hallpass_server" "web1" {
  alias = "web1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Alias.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Address.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `id` (String) Server ID.
- `kind` (String) `ssh` or `git`.
- `port` (Number) Port.
